title: Scalar extension respects the open base-change comparison
statement:
Let $A\to B$ be a homomorphism of finite commutative rings. Let
$$\begin{array}{ccc}U'&\xrightarrow h&U\\
j'\downarrow&&\downarrow j\\
X'&\xrightarrow g&X\end{array}$$
be an open-immersion square [def-cbc-open-immersion-square], with arbitrary $g$. Use ordinary unbounded constant-ring module derived categories on the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules] and their exact inverse images [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Put $S_T=-\otimes^L_{A_T}B_T$ [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings] and let $\lambda_u:u_B^{-1}S_V\xrightarrow{\sim}S_Tu_A^{-1}$ be the canonical K-flat tensor inverse-image comparison [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. Use the exact open extensions $j_!^R\dashv j_R^{-1}$, with unit $\eta_j^R$, for $R=A,B$ [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero]. Let $\beta_j:S_Xj_!^A\xrightarrow{\sim}j_!^BS_U$ be the isomorphism of left adjoints obtained from the identity between their right adjoints $j_A^{-1}\operatorname{Res}_X=\operatorname{Res}_Uj_B^{-1}$, with scalar restriction as in [lem-weil-pbc-ring-sheaf-change-adjunction]. Equivalently $\beta_{j,K}^{-1}$ is the $j_!^B\dashv j_B^{-1}$ adjunct of
$$S_UK\xrightarrow{S_U\eta_{j,K}^A}S_Uj_A^{-1}j_!^AK\xrightarrow{\lambda_{j,j_!^AK}^{-1}}j_B^{-1}S_Xj_!^AK.$$
Define $\beta_{j'}$ in the same way. Write $e_j^R:g_R^{-1}j_!^R\xrightarrow{\sim}j'_!{}^Rh_R^{-1}$ for the actual base-change map of [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-base-change]. Its inverse is the $j'_!{}^R\dashv j_R'{}^{-1}$ adjunct of $h_R^{-1}\eta_j^R$, followed by the cartesian inverse-image identification. Then for every $K\in D(U_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$,
$$j'_!{}^B(\lambda_{h,K})\circ e_{j,S_UK}^B\circ g_B^{-1}(\beta_{j,K})
=\beta_{j',h_A^{-1}K}\circ S_{X'}(e_{j,K}^A)\circ\lambda_{g,j_!^AK}.$$
This is an equality in $D(X'_{\mathrm{proet}},B)$ from $g_B^{-1}S_Xj_!^AK$ to $j'_!{}^BS_{U'}h_A^{-1}K$, natural in $K$. No flatness or finite projective-dimension hypothesis on $B$ over $A$ is imposed.
